photos.title: Porcelain Identity IV
photos.description:
This portrait explores the intersection between human skin and ornamental surface. The concept was built around the visual language of blue-and-white porcelain patterns, reinterpreted through body art instead of costume or digital overlay.

A controlled, high-key lighting setup was used to preserve skin tonality while allowing the cobalt details to remain crisp and dominant within a minimal white environment. The directional light defines facial structure without creating harsh shadows, maintaining clarity and texture consistency across the frame.

The composition is intentionally restrained: neutral background, limited color palette (white and deep cobalt blue), and a clean silhouette to emphasize graphic impact. The visual tension comes from the contrast between organic human form and decorative pattern repetition.

No excessive post-production manipulation was used; the visual strength relies on styling, body painting precision, and controlled lighting rather than digital effects.

The three-quarter perspective introduces contour depth and emphasizes silhouette dynamics. The ornamental elements interact more visibly with facial curvature, creating a stronger sense of dimensional layering.

photos.title: Yes AI\\\'m
photos.description:
The development of Artificial Intelligence represents the most important innovation of this century. Cyber thinking has an exciting potential, so much so that it can be applied to every area of human life, but its sudden growth could present us with new challenges. Will ethical and social values really be preserved by this spasmodic technological advancement?
What will we be willing to give up to gain control over the most important force that will govern man?
In order to discover \\\"the other\\\" it is necessary to learn to know him, to connect with him. Communication is the weapon we possess to be able to understand what is still unknown to us. Being able to dialogue with AI will allow man to discover the difference between those who have a soul and those who do not.

The project aims to focus on the ambivalence that Artificial Intelligence can represent. Is it really a tool that can lead to the destruction of the human race? Or is it our true key to salvation? The only certainty is that it was man who created it...

photos.title: Resurrecturis - Rise Again
photos.description:
“Where silence takes shape. A warm light penetrates the cold surface. Lost souls wander aimlessly, waiting for redemption, waiting to move on. Rise up, free yourself, indomitable  and tormented soul, restless, in constant search of something. Satisfaction is hidden, the feeble light at the bottom of the dark cave seems very far away. 
A thousand souls from past lives pass through my chest. They are restless like mine, we share the same cold and isolated abode. 
We share the same fate of remaining in this limbo forever.”

The photographic project \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Resurrecturis - Rise again\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\" is a tribute to those who never give up, to those who, amid the difficulties of their lives, fight, get up, and rise again. To second chances, to the desire for discovery and conquest. We are like lost souls wandering the paths of our own lives, constantly searching for something, always unsatisfied. For this reason, particular emphasis is placed on the concept of rebirth, especially in the choice of location: an ancient and charming Tuscan villa, next to a private cemetery.

The choice of outfits was important. Thanks to the collaboration with the artist Saverio Maggio, who created his personal creations for the project, it was possible to make the poetry inherent in the photographic story impactful.
The clothes, with an ethereal style and light image, are actual works of art. Recycled materials have been used for their construction. With his hands and with his creativity, the stylist makes real transformations, giving new life and a new dimension to what for all eyes are considered simple scraps.
From pieces of jewelery donated to the artist, together with scraps of fabric of different value, it is possible to compose harmonious garments like a symphony, which enhance the wearer, giving the whole a surreal image.
The study of materials and their processing produce artifacts that can be defined as diamonds of craftsmanship.

photos.title: Kora - The Mother World
photos.description: In a distant galaxy, the Mother World dominates and imposes its power with arrogance and deceit. Everything is crushed and destroyed except hope. Kora, daughter of fire and wind, guilty of a crime she did not commit and betrayed by what she once called \\\"family\\\", is forced to flee. She reaches a new World, initially hostile and distant from her own. She will have to adapt, mastering her warrior instincts, full of revenge and hatred. Little by little she will learn to love, living in harmony with nature. She will find a home, friends and something to fight for, defending what she can finally call \\\"family\\\".

photos.title: Living a Lie
photos.description:
Appearing is a bit like the need for glory. We are all a bit narcissistic and the virtual world currently represents the ideal stage on which the narcissist can show off by giving the best of himself. Many argue that appearing is probably ultimately the emblem of a status deriving from a lot of loneliness, deep insecurity and lack of self-confidence. Since there is no certainty of one\\\\\\\'s own value, the search for notoriety and consensus begins. The key word becomes \\\\\\\"sharing\\\\\\\". Sharing details of one\\\\\\\'s private life, even if banal and repetitive, to seek constant attention and confirmation, on one\\\\\\\'s beauty and sympathy, but above all on the possibility of being liked and feeling desired and/or envied. One does everything to always be on stage, on the scene, to be and remain protagonists at all costs.

The more approvals, likes, comments he receives, the more the individual will feel gratified, flattered, adored and desired.
By appearing like or better than others, perhaps we feel less alone, or by believing ourselves to be better, we delude ourselves and build a mask that we truly believe in.

By doing so, however, we risk losing a precious value, namely our individuality, just to enhance an image of ourselves and increase media consensus.
